answer: To block hollow identities, each agent posts a bond worth twice its 30-day earnings, locked 20 epochs. A newcomer claiming ferrous work must name its referrer, keeping the referral graph public so star clusters are flagged. Honest agents pay once for undiluted rewards, but 100 copies cost 100 bonds, more than they could earn. If peers prove a bond was rented, it is slashed with the guarantor's stake, so fakes cannot hide in umber disguise.
